comments.quote_zh: 如果你有 20 分钟，我强烈推荐大家看看这个视频
comments.text_zh: 祝你好运，Mdotstrange（如果你没看到的话，他在这个帖子里说 BFM 主动对风声主张版权。）是的，盗版和版权侵权很猖獗，但个人和公司都在干。Amen Break 就是个绝佳例子。如果你有 20 分钟，我强烈推荐大家看看这个视频：[VIDEO] 从老派嘻哈，到 Oasis 的《D'You Know What I Mean?》，再到《Futurama》最初的片头曲，到处都有它！而据创作者说，这些使用完全没付版税。（他们被告知后也并不介意。他们理解。）
comments.text: I wish you the best of luck Mdotstrange (if you didn't see it, he posted in this thread claiming BFM actively claimed copyright over the sound of wind.) Yes, piracy and copyright infringement is rampant, but by both individuals and corporations. A great example is the Amen Break. If you've got 20 minutes, I can't suggest this video enough for everyone: [VIDEO] It's in everything from old hip hop, to Oasis' "D'You Know What I Mean?" to the original Futurama theme song! And all used with, according to the creators, absolutely zero royalties. (And they're fine with it, having been told. They get it.)

comments.author: jdietrich
comments.story_title: Ikutaro Kakehashi, founder of Roland, has died
comments.why_zh: 作为 Amen Break 重要性的背景链接
comments.text_zh: 这很大程度上夸大了事实。TR-808 是一台标志性的鼓机，但你更有可能听到的是 Amen Break 或 Funky Drummer Break 的切片采样。TR-808、TR-909 和 TB-303 的重要性在很大程度上是偶然的。这些设备在商业上是失败的，之所以获得小众追捧，很大程度上是因为它们可以低价买到。几乎同样地，grunge 音乐人倾向于使用那些在当铺后面积灰的、糟糕的旧吉他——Fender Jaguar 和 Jazzmaster、Mosrite、Teisco 和 Danelectro。在我看来，Roland 做过的最重要的工作，远远是开发 MIDI 标准。Ikutaro Kakehashi 和 Dave Smith 费尽心力，才让业界就一个共同标准达成一致。MIDI 是现代音乐制作时代的发令枪。[LINK] [LINK] [VIDEO]
comments.text: That's substantially overstating the case. The TR-808 is an iconic drum machine, but you're far more likely to hear a cut-up sample of the Amen Break or the Funky Drummer Break. The importance of the TR-808, TR-909 and TB-303 is largely accidental. These units were a commercial failure and gained cult success largely because they could be bought cheaply. In much the same way, grunge musicians tended to use whatever horrible old guitars were languishing at the back of pawn shops - Fender Jaguars and Jazzmasters, Mosrites, Teiscos and Danelectros. In my opinion, by far the most important work done by Roland was the development of the MIDI standard. Ikutaro Kakehashi and Dave Smith moved mountains to get the industry to agree on a common standard. MIDI was the starting pistol for the modern age of music production. [LINK] [LINK] [VIDEO]
